title: Check the bricks mapping against its first release

acceptance: Waits on bricks' first release (none on 2026-11-25); once bricks has records, its release step joins dependsOn as bricks:<STEP-ID>
docs/STYLE-GUIDE.md has a table: each piece, its bricks token, component or pattern by exported name, or FPVBuddy-only with the reason

privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: the inventory is in the record; read bricks' exports and write one table. Not a measurement.
